# Moodie

> A tiny, deeply configurable animated SVG face for React.

Install: npm install @moodie/react motion
Repository: https://github.com/arhxam/custom-icon
License: MIT

Minimal usage:

```tsx
import { Moodie } from "@moodie/react";
<Moodie expression="happy" color="#5b6cff" />;
```

Built-in expressions: neutral, happy, excited, sleepy, sad, worried, thinking, love, curious, surprised, focused, cheeky, dizzy, calm, wink, alert.

Shapes: circle, squircle, blob, pebble, diamond.

Main props: expression, defaultExpression, expressions, expressionOrder, onExpressionChange, shape, color, eyeColor, size, eyeScale, eyeDistance, turn, flip, motion, spring, blink, pointer, auto, gaze, gazeLimit, clickAction, reaction, reducedMotion, ariaLabel.

Controlled interaction:

```tsx
const [expression, setExpression] = useState("curious");
<Moodie expression={expression} onExpressionChange={setExpression} clickAction="random" />;
```

See the repository's docs/llm-guide.md for the complete model, accessibility rules, custom geometry, and framework notes.
